gloss: new fiscal year; new academic year

definitions.gloss: new fiscal year; new academic year
definitions.explanation: The beginning of a new fiscal or academic year. In Japan, both the fiscal year and academic year start in April, making this a significant transition point for businesses, schools, and government.

examples.japanese: {新年度|しんねんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The new fiscal year has begun.

examples.japanese: {新年度|しんねんど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧だ。
examples.english: It's time to draw up the budget for the new fiscal year.

examples.japanese: {新年度|しんねんど}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧、⟦{人事異動|じんじいどう}→人事異動：18627_jinjiidou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Personnel transfers were announced ahead of the new fiscal year.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, the fiscal year ({会計年度|かいけいねんど}) and the academic year ({学年度|がくねんど}) both begin in April. The weeks surrounding April 1st are a major transition period: new employees start work, students begin new school years, and government budgets take effect.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新年度|しんねんど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧ (new fiscal year budget)
- {新年度|しんねんど}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧ (in preparation for the new year)
- {新年度|しんねんど}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (starting from the new year)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{年度|ねんど}→年度：00309_nendo⟧ (fiscal/academic year)
- ⟦{年度末|ねんどまつ}→年度末：10202_nendomatsu⟧ (end of the fiscal year — March)
- ⟦{新学期|しんがっき}→新学期：16070_shingakki⟧ (new school term)
